criteria.name: Structural Completeness
criteria.justification: The paper has an abstract, introduction, findings, discussion, and conclusion, as well as references and an appendix with tables. The structure is appropriate for an academic paper.

criteria.name: Peer Review Signals

criteria.name: Authorship & Community Alignment (IKAT)
criteria.justification: The paper does not acknowledge the Garo community specifically and does not involve them in the analysis. The authors do not provide reciprocal framing or evidence of community participation.

criteria.name: Ethical Source Handling & Consent
criteria.justification: The paper lacks information on ethical approvals or informed consent processes, which are required for proper handling of sources.

criteria.name: Experience Report Identification
criteria.justification: Paper appears to be a conventional data-driven research paper rather than an experience report.
